en: Bonus Scenario 14: A Bloodstained Love Letter
Exal, what did you want to talk about?

jp: キボートスに向かう前に
どうしても確かめておきたい
en: There's something I had to make sure of before we head for Kibotos.

jp: 確かめておきたいことって・・？
en: Something to make sure of...?

jp: お前、ラブレターもらっただろ？
en: You got a love letter, didn't you?

jp: ラブレターって・・・
雑記帳のあの書き込みのこと？
en: A love letter... You mean that message in the notebook?

jp: 呼び出しくらってるんだろ？
en: You got summoned, right? Go on, Cain.
Whaat!?

jp: 中途半端な態度が一番
相手を傷つけるんだぜ？
en: Being wishy-washy is what hurts a girl the most, you know?

jp: お前にはマティアがいるんだ
ダメならダメだとハッキリ
en: You've got Matia. If the answer's no, go tell her no, loud and clear.

jp: 別にボクは行くつもりじゃ・・・
en: But I wasn't going to go...

jp: お前には俺達が付いている！
ちゃんと見守っていてやるぜ！
en: Relax! We've got your back! We'll be watching over you the whole time!

jp: 俺達って・・・まさか
en: "We"... Don't tell me--
Oh yes, indeed~
Stayen!?

jp: それぞれの待ち合わせの場所に
en: Everyone else has already snuck into position at the meeting spots.

jp: カインを呼び出した子って
どんな子なのか楽しみよね～
en: Hee hee~ I can't wait to see what kind of girl asked Cain out~

jp: まだボクは行くだなんて・・・
en: Hold on! I never said I was going...

jp: あなた、女の子を泣かせる気？
en: Cain.... Are you planning to make a girl cry?

jp: そ、そんなつもりは・・・
en: N-no, that's not--
Then it's settled!

jp: さぁ、主役は急いで急いで！
待ち合わせに遅れちゃうわよ！
en: Now hurry, hurry, leading man! You'll be late for your date!
Somehow...
I can feel the stares....
She's late...
Nah, should be any minute now, right?

jp: カインに告白するなんて
趣味の悪い子もいたものね
en: Still, a girl who'd confess to Cain... Some people have awful taste.

jp: そんなことありません！
en: That's not true!

jp: カインさんは、素敵な方です
en: Cain-san is a wonderful person.
Oh my, how unexpected... So that's your type, is it?
Huh!?

jp: いえ、そんな、わたしは・・・
en: N-no, I, I mean... That is....
Don't tell me, Syria... Is it really true?

jp: 少しだけ、素敵だなって
思っていただけで・・・
en: No, um... I only thought he was a little bit wonderful, that's all...

jp: カインさんにはマティアさんが
en: But Cain-san already has Matia-san, so...

jp: あの、本当にほんの少しだけ
いいなっと思っていただけです
en: Um, really, I only thought he was nice. Just the tiniest bit.

jp: カインさんには秘密に・・・
en: So please, keep it a secret from Cain-san...

jp: きっと、迷惑なだけでしょうから
en: ...Something like this would surely only be a bother to him.

jp: カインが決めることでしょ？
en: Whether it's a bother or not is for Cain to decide, isn't it?

jp: 欲しいなら奪っちゃえばいいのよ
en: If you want him, just take him.
...I suppose you're right.

jp: カインさんみたいな弟が
いたらいいと思ったのですが
en: I did think it would be nice if Lilis had a little brother like Cain-san.

jp: お姉さんは、マティアさん一人に
限定しなきゃいけないわけでは
en: After all, there's no rule that says his big sister has to be Matia-san alone.

jp: そっか！　そうだよね！
お姉さんはたくさんでも
en: Right! That's right! It's fine to have lots of big sisters!

jp: 今度カインさんに頼んで
en: Yes, exactly! Let's ask Cain-san next time.

jp: リリスにも弟が出来るの～♪
en: Yay! Lilis is getting a little brother~
Ahahaha... So she wants him as a little brother.

jp: せいぜい、そんなところだろ
en: That's about the extent of it, I'd say.

jp: 誰か来たみたいですよ！
en: Ah! I think someone's coming!
Hide!!
Fwahahahaha!

jp: のこのこと、本当に一人で
en: Strolling in all alone, just like that!
...Who were you again?
Ngah!

jp: このクッタ様を忘れるとは
en: Forgetting the great Kutta!? Who do you think you are, you blockhead!!

jp: 呼び出したのは・・・
en: Don't tell me... the one who called me out here was...
That's right! It was the great Kutta!

jp: 色ボケしたマセガキめ！
貴様なんぞに愛の告白シーンなど
en: You lovesick little brat! You're ten years too early for a love confession scene!!
...I'm going home.

jp: このクッタ様を無視するな！
en: Wait!! Don't ignore the great Kutta!
...Did you want something?

jp: 俺はようやく理解したのだ
en: After defeat upon defeat, I have finally come to understand.
Understand what?
You are my sworn enemy!

jp: 我が野望を打ち砕きに現れる
次世代の救世主候補なのだと！
en: The savior of the next generation, who will soon rise to crush my ambitions!

jp: 今この瞬間貴様を消し去れば
クッタ様の未来に陰を落とす者
en: Erase you here and now, and nothing will darken the great Kutta's future!!

jp: このクッタ様のものに・・・
en: And then this world will belong to the great Kutta...
Ngah!?

jp: 人の話は最後まで聞くのが
en: Curse you! It's only good manners to hear a man out!!
Come out! You chick-head!
Let's go, Exal.

jp: 関わらないに限るよな
en: Yeah. Best not to get involved.

jp: くそう、こうなれば・・・
en: Damn it, in that case...

jp: 白バンダナのヤツ、手を挙げろ！
en: You, chick-head's friend! The one in the white bandana, hands up!

jp: なんだ・・・俺のことか？
en: What... me?

jp: 貴様はひそかに上げ底ブーツを
en: I know! You secretly wear platform boots!!
Wha....
Who does!!

jp: 挑発に乗ったらダメだよ！
en: E-Exal, calm down! Don't rise to the bait!

jp: 腹筋ムキムキの黒羽根の男！
en: I know more! The black-wing with the bulging abs!

jp: 常時、斧なんぞかつぎおって
周囲に大迷惑な貴様だ！
en: Yes, you! Always lugging that axe around, a nuisance to everyone nearby!

jp: そんなに見せたいのか？！
en: You! Do you want to show them off that badly?!
If you want to show off that badly, take it all off and be proud!!
Who...
Next, the ex-monk soldier woman!
Wh-what...
You! Your figure is.....
...No, I'll leave it.

jp: ちょっと、なんなのよそれ！
言いたいことがあるなら
en: Hey, what's that supposed to mean!? If you've got something to say, say it!!
B-big sis! Calm down!

jp: それから白き四翼の女と
en: Next, the white-winged woman with four wings and her little sister!
U-us?

jp: 貴様らは可愛いから問題なし！
en: You two are cute, so no problem!
What's with that!? Why the different treatment!?

jp: それから、悪魔討伐隊の男！
en: Next, the man from the demon-hunting squad!
...Surely you don't mean me?

jp: 戯れ言は聞き流して下さい
en: Kreis, please just let his nonsense wash over you.
Understood.
Fwahahaha! I know!

jp: 貴様、プロデヴォン教団で
en: You're a mechanized monk soldier, secretly modified by the Prodevon Church!

jp: 美少年だが実は年齢不詳の
あの天使に改造されたのだろう！
en: Modified by that angel, the pretty boy of indeterminate age! It must be so!

jp: 絶対に自爆スイッチとか
en: You've definitely got a self-destruct switch somewhere!!

jp: そして、実は悪の秘密結社と
戦っていたりするのだろう！！？
en: And you secretly fight an evil secret society, don't you!?

jp: 妙な期待をされているような
気がするのだが・・・
en: It seems... I am being saddled with some rather odd expectations...

jp: そのようですが・・・
バカは放っておくのが一番ですわ
en: So it seems... But it's best to leave fools be.
And now, the grand finale!
The six-winged angel!

jp: 貴様は絶対に、シス・・・
en: You, without a doubt, are a sis--
What about me?
Y-you! Since when!?
That's enough, Kutta.

jp: ・・か、帰って行ったのでは
en: ..D-didn't you go home!?

jp: 仲間連れとはどういうことだ？！
en: And what's this... you brought friends?!

jp: あることないこと好き放題に
言いやがって・・・・
en: Spouting off whatever you please, truth and lies alike....
Prepare yourself!!!

jp: 返り討ちにしてくれるわ！！
en: Fwahahahaha! You'll be the ones cut down!!
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
